screened.motion: This house believes coding agents are making engineers worse at their jobs.
screened.why: Claude is assigned to argue against, yet it admits its side has the weaker long-term case and expects juniors to be losing understanding, so it shares Gemini's core worry and differs mainly on whether the harm is already proven.

screened.motion: This house believes companies should cap engineers' daily AI spending rather than let them use as much as they need.
screened.why: Although Claude was assigned the side against, it says that if forced to choose it leans slightly toward capping, so both agents favor some limit on spending over unlimited use.

screened.motion: This house believes today's AI token prices are sustainable, and fears of a sharp price rise are overblown.
screened.why: Both think per-token API prices are sustainable and that only flat-rate subscriptions will tighten, even though Claude was assigned to argue against the motion.
